notes.key_messages: • Interpretation of diagrams, including the standard demand curve, was a particular problem.
notes.general_comments:
Although there was a significant increase in candidates from 100 to 156, this still left the total entry too small
to allow statistically incontrovertible conclusions about performance. The mean score fell from 20.4 to 16.5.
While full marks were gained by two candidates, the same as in the previous year, the number scoring 8 or
below rose from 0 to 16.
